date_note: The page, published 27 November, says the company reported the attack on Friday morning (27 November).
exec: Eyoon Masr reports Octopus said customer and merchant data was exposed in a cyberattack, and some services might be temporarily affected as a precaution.
geo_basis: country: Octopus is Hong Kong's payment operator; the page gives no city
plain: Eyoon Masr reports Hong Kong's Octopus payment operator said a cyberattack exposed some customer and merchant data. Octopus said no credit card or bank account data was affected.

sources.name: Eyoon Masr: a whole city's wallet in hackers' sights (Arabic)

summary: Eyoon Masr reports, citing the South China Morning Post, that Octopus, operator of Hong Kong's electronic payment system, reported a cyberattack on its systems on Friday morning and said customer and merchant data was exposed. The page says Octopus stated no credit card or bank account data was affected. It also says Hong Kong's Privacy Commissioner confirmed receiving a breach notification and began a compliance review.
title: Octopus reports cyberattack exposing customer and merchant data, Eyoon Masr reports

validation.note: One publisher (Eyoon Masr, Arabic) relaying Octopus's statement as reported by SCMP; the SCMP and Octopus pages were not read and no second publisher was found.

review.note: date, no card/bank data, privacy commissioner review, single_source against Eyoon Masr
